scope_method: First six evidence-found attempts after skipping the eight B100 unresolved entries, covering two exact target records; audit the targets sequentially.
allowed_work: One evidence-only Luna worker may audit the two targets sequentially, inspecting only each scoped attempt, its accepted source records, and the exact candidate before moving to the next target. Report source-to-target fit and all generation/build/date/measurement caveats. Recommend source reuse only where the candidate already represents supported claims. Do not inspect sibling models or out-of-scope files. No browsing, edits, candidate value changes, image rights assumptions, or clearance inference from fitted tire widths.
done_criteria: All six attempts receive exact-source-backed source-reuse or unresolved recommendations.
Primary writer integrates only defensible ledger resolutions and leaves missing numeric values or current-route claims unchanged.
Fresh data:gaps and research:queue quantify post-batch status.
Run validate, research:check, monotonic coverage acceptance/check and git diff --check; no full gate or image report unless product/source/image records change.
